description: Review of the commit that made a string mark a name only where a member's name is read: `Reflect['get'](ctx, 'skip')()` reads the context's `skip` through `Reflect` under a subscript, which the position checks did not see. The callee's whole subtree is read — the arguments of the inner call included — and it holds the string `'skip'`, a token of the vocabulary: at least a WARN that it may skip 'adds'. The real runner skips the test.
